1100 Ω ± 100 Ω for 250 kg up to and incl. 10 t
1200 Ω ± 100 Ω for 13 t
1075 Ω ± 100 Ω for 28 t
1350 Ω ± 200 Ω for 60 t

Safe overload 150 % of Emax

1025 Ω ± 25 Ω for 250 kg up to and incl. 10 t

930 Ω ± 0,5 Ω for 28 t
1175 Ω ± 0,5 Ω for 60 t

101 --- NMi # OIML Certificate of Conformity **OIML Member State** The Netherlands Number R60/2000-NL1-16.04 Project number SO16200084 Page 3 of 3
Transducer material Stainless steel
Atmospheric protection Hermetically welded
The characteristics for nmax and Y can be reduced separately. Each produced load cell is provided with an accompanying document with information about its characteristics. 101
